citation.title: Effect of curing and silanizing on composite repair bond strength using an improved micro-tensile test method

s_design.anchor: in-vitro micro-tensile repair bond strength study with a previously published test method, statistics per ISO/TS 11405:2015, defined water storage and thermocycling, 51-66 rods per subgroup (MATERIAL in-vitro validated-protocol row, 85)
s_design.evidence_quote: Our recently published and much less time consuming method was used to attach the specimen rods

domains.evidence_quote: The main objective was to evaluate the repair bond
domains.note: objective and three null hypotheses stated explicitly in the Introduction

absence: read Materials and methods (block fabrication, aging, grouping, sectioning, testing, statistics) and Results; no sample size calculation, power analysis or justification for 80 blocks / 4 blocks per subgroup anywhere in the text

domains.evidence_quote: The 80 aged blocks were randomly divided into two
domains.note: random allocation stated for the A/B split only, with no method described; allocation to the adhesive and cured/uncured subgroups is described as 'further divided' with no statement of randomization

absence: read Materials and methods (specimen preparation, repair, sectioning, microscopic screening of rods, tensile testing, fracture classification) and Discussion; no blinding of operator, of the rod-screening examiner or of the fracture-mode assessor, and no blind/blinded/masked wording anywhere in the text

domains.evidence_quote: Statistical calculations done were according to suggestions from ISO/TS 11405:2015 on treatment of
domains.note: analysis framework cited and p values reported, but the statistical test is never named and the unit of analysis (rod vs block) is not stated; the unit-of-analysis critical flaw is not fired because the text does not make it unmistakable

domains.evidence_quote: The authors report no conflicts of interest.
domains.note: conflict-of-interest statement present; funding source not stated anywhere (Acknowledgements and Disclosure statement read)

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement, or manufacturer funding of own tested product without independent-analysis statement
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors report no conflicts of interest.
penalties.note: conflict-of-interest statement present; no manufacturer funding reported
not applicable: in-vitro study, not an RCT

penalties.item: no sample size justification / in-vitro specimen count per group <10 with no justification
penalties.note: covered in Q_method (QUIN sample size justification rated high); 51-66 rods per subgroup reported

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: not applicable: laboratory bond strength outcome with defined artificial aging, no clinical survival claim

fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۲۶ از ۱۰۰ و در باند D (شواهد ضعیف) برای نوع سؤال MATERIAL است.
interpretation_fa: طراحی آزمایشگاهی این مطالعه با نگهداری شش‌ماهه در آب و ترموسایکلینگ برای سؤال مواد مناسب است، اما توجیه حجم نمونه و بلایندینگ در متن گزارش نشده و ضریب کیفیت روش پایین آمده است. افزایش استحکام باند ترمیم با سایلن و کیور نکردن باندینگ یافته‌ای آزمایشگاهی است و نتیجه‌ی بالینی گزارش نشده است.
